summary: KIRKEBRANN Jens-Kristian Sevik (org. no. 996 691 683) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Horten, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2011-03-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 90.201 (Utøvende kunstnerisk virksomhet og underholdningsvirksomhet innenfor musikk); it has 0 registered employees.
